args.sql:
WITH tool_wear_rate AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.effectivenessrobot AS robot_id,
        SUM(t1.toolwearpct) / t2.progcyclecount AS twr
    FROM 
        "performance_and_safety" AS t1
    JOIN operation AS t2 ON t1.effectivenessrobot = t2.operbotdetref
    GROUP BY 
        t1.effectivenessrobot, t2.progcyclecount
),
tool_replacement_status AS (
    SELECT 
        robot_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN twr > 0.001 AND tpc > 10000 THEN 'URGENT'
            WHEN twr > 0.0005 OR AVG(toolwearpct) > 75 THEN 'WARNING'
            ELSE 'NORMAL'
        END AS tool_status
    FROM 
        tool_wear_rate AS t1
    JOIN "performance_and_safety" AS t2 ON t1.robot_id = t2.effectivenessrobot
    GROUP BY 
        robot_id, twr, tpc
)
SELECT 
    t1.effectivenessrobot AS robot_id,
    AVG(t1.toolwearpct) AS avg_tool_usage_severity,
    twr AS twr_value,
    tpc AS tpc_value,
    AVG(t2.cycletimesecval) AS avg_cycle_time_sec,
    trs.tool_status
FROM 
    "performance_and_safety" AS t1
JOIN operation AS t2 ON t1.effectivenessrobot = t2.operbotdetref
JOIN tool_wear_rate AS twr ON t1.effectivenessrobot = twr.robot_id
JOIN tool_replacement_status AS trs ON t1.effectivenessrobot = trs.robot_id
GROUP BY 
    t1.effectivenessrobot, twr, tpc, trs.tool_status
ORDER BY 
    twr DESC;
